=== short branches both ways
start:
        bz start
        bnz 1f
        br 1f
        bsa 1f
        nop
1:      bge start
        blt 1b
=== a conditional branch relaxes to 17 bits first
        bnz far
        bsa far
        br far
        .space 0x200
far:    nop
=== and past 17 bits to an inverted branch over jr
        bz vfar
        bsa vfar
        br vfar
        .space 0x10000
vfar:   nop
=== backward branches of each size
back:   nop
        .space 0x100
        bz back
        bsa back
        .space 0x10000
        bz back
        bsa back
        br back
=== the boundaries of the 17-bit branch
        bz fwd
        .space 0xfffa
fwd:    nop
back:   .space 0x10000
        bz back
=== one past the boundaries of the 17-bit branch
        bz fwd
        .space 0xfffc
fwd:    nop
back:   .space 0x10002
        bz back
=== branches to an undefined symbol far from the section start
# GNU as sizes these as if `ext` were at address 0, so they need to be further
# from it than any short form reaches for the two assemblers to agree.
        .space 0x20004
        bz ext
        bsa ext
        br ext
        jr ext
        jarl ext, lp
        loop r2, ext
=== loop back to a label
top:    add 1, r6
        loop r7, top
        mov 5, r8
1:      nop
        loop r8, 1b
=== loop to the edge of its reach
top:    nop
        .space 0xfffc
        loop r1, top
=== loop forward is two instructions
        loop r3, fwd
        nop
fwd:    nop
=== a function with prepare and dispose
func:
        prepare {r20-r22, r29, lp}, 2
        mov r6, r20
        movea 0x100, r0, r21
        jarl callee, lp
        mov r10, r22
        add r20, r10
        dispose 2, {r20-r22, r29, lp}, [lp]
callee:
        prepare {lp}, 0, sp
        dispose 0, {lp}
        jmp [lp]
=== hilo() and friends of symbols leave the fields to relocations
        mov hilo(foo), r1
        prepare {}, 0, hilo(foo)
        prepare {}, 0, hi(foo)
        prepare {}, 0, lo(foo)
        prepare {}, 0, foo
        ld.b lo23(foo)[r1], r2
        st.w r2, lo23(foo)[r1]
        ld.bu lo(foo)[r1], r2
=== hi() and lo() of a local label are relocated against the section
        movhi hi(data), r0, r1
        movea lo(data), r1, r1
        mov hilo(data), r2
        .space 0x8000
data:   .long 1
=== label differences resolve
start:  movea end - start, r0, r1
        mov hilo(end - start), r2
        ld.bu (end - start)[r1], r2
        ld.w (end - start)[r1], r2
        nop
end:
=== a saturating accumulate with bins and rotl
        mov 0, r10
        bins r6, 8, 8, r10
        rotl 4, r10, r11
        satadd r11, r10, r12
        cmov lt, r12, r10, r13
        sch1l r13, r14
        jmp [lp]
=== floating point, single and double
        cmpf.s olt, r6, r7
        trfsr
        cmovf.s r6, r7, r10
        addf.d r6, r8, r10
        cvtf.ds r10, r11
        jmp [lp]
